productConcept.name: Meridian Grain
productConcept.description: A precision film developing and scanning laboratory that treats film chemistry as a scientific discipline — custom push-pull development, large-format scanning to 6400 dpi, and archival platinum-palladium contact printing for working photographers and editorial clients.
productConcept.rationale: The pale-engine design system presents a warm cream/off-white base (#f2efe9) with a vibrant orange primary action (#fb7339), condensed grotesque body type (Archivo Narrow), and sharp mechanical display type (Bricolage Grotesque) with 0.06em uppercase tracking — signals that map to precision craft with industrial vocabulary. The nav system describes itself as 'a luxury retail navigation system with disciplined architectural restraint.' This combination — industrial condensed type, warm earthy palette, orange chemical-indicator accent, luxury-grade nav choreography — fits a precision analog photography lab perfectly: the orange reads as chemical indicator color, the cream as photographic paper, the compressed grotesque as technical vocabulary. The concept avoids the gravitational pull toward French artisan food / Maison-style branding and instead lands in the world of chemistry, archival craft, and reproducible process — an entirely different product world from the Hardware Design IDE previously built in this directory.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion.json has non-trivial durations (0.3s, 0.45s, 0.75s), named easing curve (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)), and concept_by_video.md documents rich scroll-triggered cinematic reveals with strict content hierarchy sequencing.
